summary.plain: The international team building Hyper-Kamiokande: about 650 researchers from 23 countries have taken part.
summary.technical: International collaboration for the Hyper-Kamiokande experiment; about 650 researchers from 23 countries had participated as of October 2025, per the collaboration's own page. Traces to a 2015 ICRR-KEK memorandum of understanding; the project itself was formally approved by the Japanese government in February 2020.
